decision.rationale: Single trial 8c700086 used symmetric both-on then both-off excitation, so cross-channel and independent dynamics are poorly separated. AR1 vs AR2 training RMSE (0.117 vs 0.111C) is close with no whole-trial validation, so order is unresolved and AR families remain predictive only, not mechanistic. Staggered gives highest D-optimal gain per parameter for improved excitation and separates q1-only, both-on, q2-only phases to address the unresolved AR1 vs AR2 predictive ambiguity next.
